value.title: Value Quality Scanner
value.intro: Ranks every stock in the S&P 500, 400 and 600 on five tests: PEG, debt-to-equity, ROIC, free-cash-flow yield and P/E. Change any threshold and the board re-scores instantly.

bluechip.title: Blue Chip Board
bluechip.eyebrow: S&P 100 + Dow 30 · quality at a fair price
bluechip.intro: The largest, most established US companies, scored on the same five tests with thresholds sized for mega-caps, which rarely trade at small-cap multiples.

etf.title: ETF Value Board
etf.intro: Broad-market, value, dividend, sector and international ETFs, scored on cost, size, valuation of their holdings, long-run return and income.
